title: US military fires on cargo ship in Gulf of Oman over alleged blockade breach
detail: A feed summary reports the US military fired on a cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman after it reportedly tried to breach the US blockade of Iran. Only the headline summary was available; the vessel, damage and casualties are not disclosed and the report is unverified.

title: US launches task force to disrupt Iran's land-based supply routes
detail: Al Jazeera reports the US has launched a task force aimed at disrupting Iran's land-based supply routes, targeting the ground transport of weapons and materiel.
